cues.speaker: ANGELA
cues.text: Hello, Flanders conference hotel.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Oh, hi. I wanted to ask about conference facilities at the hotel. Have I come through to the right person?

cues.speaker: ANGELA
cues.text: You have. I’m the customer services manager. My name’s (Example) Angela. So how can I help you?

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Well, I’m calling from Barrett and Stansons, we’re a medical company based in Perth.

cues.speaker: ANGELA
cues.text: Oh yes.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: And we’re organising a conference for our clients to be held in Sydney. It’ll be held over two days and we’re expecting about fifty or sixty people.

cues.speaker: ANGELA
cues.text: When were you thinking of having it?

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Some time early next year, like the end of January? It’d have to be a weekend.

cues.speaker: ANGELA
cues.text: Let me see … our conference facilities are already booked for the weekend beginning January 28th. We could do the first weekend in February?

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: How about January 21st?

cues.speaker: ANGELA
cues.text: I’m afraid that’s booked too.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Well, let’s go for the February date then.

cues.speaker: ANGELA
cues.text: So that’s the weekend beginning the 4th.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: OK. Now can you tell me a bit about what conference facilities you have?

cues.speaker: ANGELA
cues.text: Sure. So for talks and presentations we have the Tesla room.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Sorry?

cues.speaker: ANGELA
cues.text: (Q1) Tesla – that’s spelled T-E-S-L-A. it holds up to a hundred people, and it’s fully equipped with a projector and so on.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: How about a (Q2) microphone?

cues.speaker: ANGELA
cues.text: Yes, that’ll be all set up ready for you, and there’ll be one that members of the audience can use too, for questions, if necessary.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Fine. And we’ll also need some sort of open area where people can sit and have a cup of coffee, and we’d like to have an (Q3) exhibition of our products and services there as well, so that’ll need to be quite a big space.

cues.speaker: ANGELA
cues.text: That’s fine, there’s a central atrium with all those facilities, and you can come before the conference starts if you want to set everything up.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Great. And I presume there’s (Q4) wifi?

cues.speaker: ANGELA
cues.text: Oh yes, that’s free and available throughout the hotel.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: OK.

cues.speaker: ANGELA
cues.text: Would you also like us to provide a buffet lunch? We can do a two-course meal with a number of different options.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: What sort of price are we looking at for that?

cues.speaker: ANGELA
cues.text: Well, I can send you a copy of the standard menu. That’s (Q5) $45 per person. Or you can have the special for $25 more.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: I think the standard should be OK, but yes, send me the menu.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Now we’re also going to need accommodation on the Saturday night for some of the participants … I’m not sure how many, but probably about 25. So what do you change for a room?

cues.speaker: ANGELA
cues.text: Well, for conference attendees we have a 25% reduction, so we can offer you rooms at (Q6) $135. Normally a standard room’s $180.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: And does that include breakfast?

cues.speaker: ANGELA
cues.text: Sure. And of course, guests can also make use of all the other facilities at the hotel. So we’ve got a spa where you can get massages and facials and so on, and there’s a (Q7) pool up on the roof for the use of guests.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Great. Now what about transport links? The hotel’s downtown, isn’t it?

cues.speaker: ANGELA
cues.text: Yes, it’s about 12 kilometres from the (Q8) airport, but there’s a complimentary shuttle bus for guests. And it’s only about ten minutes’ walk from the central railway station.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: OK. Now, I don’t know Sydney very well, can you just give me an idea of the location of the hotel?

cues.speaker: ANGELA
cues.text: Well, it’s downtown on Wilby Street, that’s quite a small street, and it’s not very far from the (Q9) sea. And of course if the conference attendees want to go out on the Saturday evening there’s a huge choice of places to eat. Then if they want to make a night of it, they can go on to one of the (Q10) clubs in the area – there are a great many to choose from.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: OK. So if we go ahead with this, can you give me some information about how much …
